title: 第十九章 社死大礼包
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
秦弦的眼瞳宛如一潭死水，仿佛外界的一切都与自己无关，像只与世隔绝的鹤。

    他冷淡地看着因自己而起的闹剧，内心没有半点被搭救的希冀，只有被人垂涎觊觎的恶心。

    他压下心里的厌恶，挥袂欲走。

    施晴讥讽地睨了萧姚一眼，用眼神示意自己的侍从，将人拦下。

    “秦公子，请吧。”

    秦弦低头看着拦在身前的手，不耐地拧了拧眉，回身的瞬间又恢复了平淡。

    “承蒙施少主厚爱，秦弦不敢高攀，您也请回。”

    施晴脸色一僵。

    一声嗤笑打破宁静，施晴恼怒地寻声望去。

    程宛君倚在萧姚肩上，笑得明目张胆。

    “就这？施少城主，看来您的面子，也没有你想得那么大嘛。”

    直白的嘲讽像一个巴掌，狠狠抽在施晴脸上，施晴脸色一阵白一阵红，怒火中烧：

    “来人，把他绑走！”

    萧姚站起身，把椅子踹过去，挡在秦弦和施晴中间，冲着极乐馆掌事抬了抬眉：

    “告诉你们当家的，如果今天人被她带走，日后就别再登神机门的大门。”

    秦弦的手隐在宽大袖子里，攥紧了拳，为了拨弦而保养极好的指甲深深掐在掌心。

    被两个纨绔当做玩物争来抢去？

    奇耻大辱！

    苍岚垂首站在一侧，眼神幽暗。

    “萧大小姐远道而来，真是让小馆蓬荜生辉。”

    “大小姐的眼光之高，天底下谁人不知？大小姐来我极乐馆享乐，那是小人的福分，秦弦能入了大小姐的法眼，那也是他的造化。”

    “少城主，您不是最喜欢热情火辣的吗？秦弦他性子冷，不会讨好人，小人给您备了小辣椒，保管让您满意。”

    极乐馆的馆主姗姗来迟。他脸上带着热情的笑容，三两句就化解了无形的硝烟。

    两名长相妖艳的男子一左一右缠上施晴，撒娇卖痴想把人勾走。

    “秦弦，懂些事，给萧大小姐斟酒。”

    自从邵馆主现身，秦弦的脸色就更难看了。

    邵馆主给他台阶下，他却像是回想起不堪回首的往事，单薄的身子微微颤抖，被飘逸的衣物无限放大。

    “不喜欢就算了。走吧，去房里给本小姐弹琴听。”

    萧姚将秦弦的反应尽收眼底，亲自又给秦弦搬了个台阶下。

    秦弦隐忍地咬着下唇，后退半步，仿佛受到了致命的羞辱。

    萧姚心里暗叫不好。坏菜，好像戳着他某根敏感的神经了……

    萧姚有点麻爪。

    嘶……这攻略对象，戒备心也太重了。

    刚被邵馆主活跃起来的气氛又降到冰点，施晴揽着美人儿，脸上写满了幸灾乐祸。

    邵馆主生怕交易黄了，眼神一恨，就要继续逼秦弦低头。
content_en:
Qin Xian's eyes were like a pool of stagnant water, as if everything in the outside world had nothing to do with him, like a crane isolated from the world.

He looked at the farce caused by him indifferently, without any hope of being rescued, only the disgust of being coveted.

He suppressed the disgust in his heart and waved his hands to leave.

Shi Qing glanced at Xiao Yao sarcastically, and signaled her attendant to stop him with her eyes.

"Master Qin, please."

Qin Xian lowered his head and looked at the hand in front of him, frowning impatiently, and returned to his calmness the moment he turned around.

"Thanks to the kindness of Young Master Shi, Qin Xian doesn't dare to climb high, so please come back."

Shi Qing's face stiffened.

A sneer broke the silence, and Shi Qing looked for his voice angrily.

Cheng Wanjun leaned on Xiao Yao's shoulder and smiled openly.

"That's it? City Lord Shi, it seems that your face is not as big as you think."

The straightforward ridicule was like a slap, hitting Shi Qing's face hard. Shi Qing's face turned white and red, and he was burning with anger:

"Someone, kidnap him!"

Xiao Yao stood up, kicked his chair over, stood between Qin Xian and Shi Qing, and raised his eyebrows at the director of the Paradise Pavilion:

"Tell your boss, if you are taken away by her today, don't go to the gate of Shenjimen again in the future."

Qin Xian's hands were hidden in his wide sleeves, clenched into fists, and the nails that were well maintained for plucking the strings were dug into his palms.

Being fought over as a plaything by two dudes?

What a shame!

Cang Lan stood on one side with her head lowered, her eyes dark.

"Miss Xiao came all the way and really made the restaurant shine."

"Who in the world doesn't know that the eldest lady has such high vision? The eldest lady comes to my Paradise Pavilion to have fun. That is the blessing of the little man. Qin Xian is able to fall under the eldest lady's discernment. It is also his good fortune."

"Young City Master, don't you like passionate people the most? Qin Xian is cold-tempered and doesn't know how to please others. I have prepared some small peppers for you and will keep them to your satisfaction."

The owner of the Paradise Pavilion arrived late.With a warm smile on his face, he dissolved the invisible smoke in a few words.

Two coquettish-looking men entangled Shi Qing, one on the left and the other on the right, acting coquettishly and trying to lure her away.

"Qin Xian, if you know something, pour some wine for Miss Xiao."

Ever since Master Shao showed up, Qin Xian's expression became even more ugly.

Master Shao let him go down the steps, but he seemed to be recalling the past that he couldn't bear to look back on. His thin body trembled slightly, which was infinitely magnified by the flowing clothes.

"Forget it if you don't like it. Let's go and play the piano for me in the room."

Xiao Yao had a clear view of Qin Xian's reaction and personally moved Qin Xian down the stairs.

Qin Xian bit his lower lip forbearingly and took half a step back, as if he had been fatally humiliated.

Xiao Yao secretly cried out.The bad dish seems to have poked a sensitive nerve in him...

Xiao Yao is a little numb.

Hiss... This target is too wary.

The atmosphere that had just been enlivened by Master Shao dropped to freezing point again. Shi Qing hugged the beauty with gloating written all over her face.

The owner of Shao Hall was afraid that the deal would go wrong. With a look of hatred in his eyes, he would continue to force Qin Xian to bow his head.
